searchText: there is a middle ground where a client generates everything it can and then the validator user can say "don't broadcast anything in this time frame, bc i'm not sure" which will likely be better than getting slashed i've been tossing around the idea of a third-party service of "validator operation" backups as a kind of insurance for this there is a tricky design question when you get to this stuff which is the trade-off b/t protecting a validator's stake and the effective moral hazard generated via insurance
